description:
Carry out an inspection and submit the verdict (manual chapters 7 and 8).

One inspection is taken from start to Completed, step by step, so the tests
run in order and share state: start → checklists → item form rules → record
items → pause/continue → verdict → completed view → edit an item.
Needs an Assigned/Accepted request (it is consumed).
